translated_title: Mexico's Culture Secretary Proposes Zero Tax Rate for Small and Medium Bookstores; It Would Mean a Tax Benefit of Some 250 Million Pesos
original_title: Propone Cultura tasa cero a librerías chicas y medianas; significaría beneficio fiscal de unos 250 mdp: Curiel de Icaza
author: Reyes Martínez Torrijos
meta_description: Culture Secretary Claudia Curiel outlined a zero sales-tax rate for small bookstores, 50 million pesos in bulk book buys, aid for state book fairs, and a Vasconcelos Library overhaul.
